lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
خ/و/ف   kh–w–f fear, fright, to fear, to frighten
; awe, concern, worry; to know, to suspect, to become aware; unworthy act; fighting, to decrease, to shorten.

Of this root, 8 forms occur 124 times in the Qur’an:
خَافَ khāfa 83 times; خَوَّفَ khawwafa 4 times; خَوْفٌ khawf 26 times; خَائِفٌ khāʾif 2 times; خَائِفُون khāʾifūn 1 time; خِيفَةٌ khıfatun 6 times; تَخْوِيفٌ takhwıf 1 time and تَخَوُّفٌ takhawwuf 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
خَوْفٌ khawf [v. n./n.]

1 fear, peril, dread

(4:83) وَإِذَا جَاءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مِنَ الأَمْنِ أَوِ الْخَوْفِ أَذَاعُوا بِهِ whenever there comes to them [news of any] matter concerning safety or peril, they spread it around

2 worry, concern

(10:62) أَلاَ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ as for those who are close to God, there [should] be no concern about them, nor shall they grieve.

entries.label: تَخَوُّفٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَخَوُّفٌ takhawwuf [v. n.] interpreted as either reducing, decreasing, lessening, or as fearing, dreading *

(16:47) أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَى تَخَوُّفٍ or He/punishment overtakes them by gradual decrease in fortune (or, He/it takes them by fear).

entries.label: تَخْوِيفٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَخْوِيفٌ takhwıf [v. n.] the act of warning

(17:59) وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِالآيَاتِ إِلاَّ تَخْوِيفًا We do not send the signs except to give warning.

entries.label: خَائِفٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
خَائِفٌ khāʾif [quasi‐act. part., pl. خَائِفُون khāʾifūn] (one) experiencing fear, being afraid, fearful

(28:21) فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَائِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ so he left the city, fearful and vigilant.

entries.label: خَافَ
entries.definitionHtml:
خَافَ khāfa a [v. trans.]

1 to fear

(8:26) تَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ afraid that people might grab you from all directions

2 to be in awe of, to revere

(55:46) وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ as for him who reveres the majesty of his Lord there are two gardens

3 to worry or be anxious about something, to be concerned

(4:9) وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا خَافُوا عَلَيْهِمْ and let those who, if they left behind them weak offspring, would be concerned for them [lest someone would treat them as badly] fear [in their behaviour towards orphans]

4 to sense, to experience, to come against

(4:128) وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَنْ يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحًا and if a wife experiences high‐handedness or alienation on her husband’s part, neither of them will be faulted if they agree between themselves on a settlement.

entries.label: خِيفَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
خِيفَةٌ khıfatun [v. n./n.]

1 fear, dread

(30:28) تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ do you fear them with the fear [you have] for each other?

2 awe

(13:13) وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ the thunder sings His praises, and [so do] the angels, in awe of Him.

entries.label: يُخَوِّفُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُخَوِّفُ yukhawwif [imperf. of v. II خَوَّفَ khawwafa, trans.]

1 to cause to fear, to frighten

(3:175) إِنَّمَا ذَلِكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ فَلاَ تَخَافُوهُمْ that Satan only intimidates his followers, so do not fear them

2 to warn, to admonish

(39:16) ذَلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ with that God warns His servants.
